original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Price the boundary debt of zxv's p3 H branch (the PR4359 H local response with its three interval endpoint corrections) against the selected conditional kappa 0.00302015, and close three decoder routes for that debt: whole-bank Q events, port-subset corrections, and gather/compression decoders through the rank-8 bottleneck of H-I.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a new local cost interface; the H local response is such an interface, but this package does not construct one. It screens the existing H interface with exact moments and records why the boundary decoders available at fixed H, owners and controller cannot fund it.
bottleneck_link: The H branch is the only open proposal with a raw ceiling far above the frontier (complex root 0.00638 with a free boundary, 0.00404 with one shared head correction). Its sole blocker is the three-interval boundary correction; this package states the exact budget (322 complex / 397 BIT rank-one calls at kappa 0.00302015) and shows which decoder classes cannot meet it.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact budget, the root table and the three scoped closures; no new decoder, controller or H construction is attempted here.
evidence: RESULT.json: raw surpluses 616/645, budgets 322/397 at 0.00302015 with budget+1 certified negative, roots for k=0/one/two shared corrections and failure of the direct correction at s=0; native H112 has rank(H-I)=8 with all 112 rows and columns nonzero and H^2=I; all 112 complex q lines and all 111 BIT port lines are distinct. README.md gives the arguments and their scope.
author: Matarener (Mark), with Claude Code assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial Claude Code assistance in analysis, code and writing; exact standard-library arithmetic; no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Is there a redesigned H local family whose ports share query lines q, or whose H-I touches few ports?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Either property breaks the gather lower bound of README section 4; the budget leaves room for about 1.4 one-sided-head equivalents.
open_questions.first_step: Group the 112 complex ports by orbit of the stage owners and test whether a completion H can be chosen block-diagonal with respect to a coarser line partition, then reprice the local word.
open_questions.blocked_by: Requires changing the H112 completion and replaying its native word and helper restoration.

open_questions.question: Can a different scalar controller leave fewer Q-conjugated interval roles than the number of pairs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: With the gauge S=diag(I,Q) every odd stream carries one Q K Q endpoint; one bad role (224) would fit the budget with a ceiling near 0.0040.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate p1..p3 Laurent controllers with the existing complex_controller_factor search and record the Q-parity of each diagonal role, not only the tariff.
open_questions.blocked_by: None for the screen; any survivor still needs its full tariff and native endpoint replay.
